fnol_text: My name is Rosa Takahashi and I live at 292 Willow Terrace, Greenville, SC 29652. You can reach me on (555) 509-3752 or rosa.takahashi@example.com. A delivery driver slipped on our icy front steps on 22 June 2025 and was taken to hospital. They have said they will make a claim against us. Policy HH-2025-00168. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Takahashi on (555) 509-3752 to acknowledge the claim. Rosa confirmed the loss date as 22 June 2025.
Site visit to 292 Willow Terrace. Neighbour Priya Kaminski was present and confirmed the timeline.
Injured party Nikhil Kowalski sustained a fractured left wrist and was treated at Riverside Medical Center. Do not admit liability; refer.
